title: BuddyBet
tagline: Dive into BuddyBet, the Web3 betting platform for sports fans! Create matches, become an Oracle ensuring integrity, and enjoy social bets with friends. Decentralized and user-driven, it offers a unique betting experience where your insight shapes the game.
description:
Welcome to BuddyBet, the premier destination for Web3 sports betting aficionados. Here, the excitement of sports meets the innovation of blockchain, empowering you to create and partake in betting matches with your friends. It's more than just betting; it's about crafting the contest, making every match a testament to your passion for the game.

As an Oracle on BuddyBet, you're not just watching the game; you're an integral part of its integrity. By staking your reputation, you uphold the fairness and trust of every wager, transforming every contest into a community-driven event.

BuddyBet thrives on decentralization, giving you the authority to determine outcomes and directly influence the betting landscape. It's a place where your insights and decisions have real power, offering a uniquely democratic and engaging betting experience.

Join BuddyBet, and turn your football knowledge into the catalyst that shapes the betting world.
how_its_made:
Our project is all about bringing cutting-edge ideas and the latest tech together to make life easier for our users, especially when it comes to hopping on board and working with smart contracts across different blockchain networks. Here's a quick dive into how we made it happen, from the tech we chose to the clever solutions we're especially proud of.

What We Used

Social Logins, Thanks to Dynamic: We kicked things off by making sign-ins a breeze with social media accounts, all thanks to Dynamic. This move was all about getting rid of those pesky barriers that might scare off folks new to the whole blockchain scene.

Where We're Live: We've got our app and all its bits and pieces up and running on Base and Arbitrum. We went with them because they're not only speedy and cheap (when it comes to those annoying gas fees) but also have a solid community and infrastructure that support all kinds of dApps.

Chiliz – A Bit of a Challenge: We wanted to play nice with as many blockchains as we could, but Chiliz threw us a curveball. We had issues deploying on the testnet (spent 20x times more than on other chains)
Its focus on sports and entertainment is otherwise a perfect match for our product

Making It All Work

Smooth Moves with wagmi^2: One big win for us was integrating wagmi^2, a set of hooks for Ethereum that made dealing with blockchain networks and smart contracts smoother, giving our users a much better experience.

Smart Picks in Tech: By choosing Dynamic for social logins and deploying on Base and Arbitrum, we managed to leverage their strengths, like scalability and community support, to our advantage.

Looking Ahead - Paymasters and More: We're gearing up to introduce Paymasters and dive deeper into account abstraction. Our goal? To make dealing with transactions a piece of cake for our users, so they don't have to stress over gas fees or the nitty-gritty of wallet management.

Getting Creative with Chiliz: Working with Chiliz meant we had to get a bit creative due to its unique niche and infrastructure. But we adapted and kept our app as welcoming and flexible as we could, despite a few hurdles.

In a nutshell, our project is a shining example of how smart choices in technology and strong partnerships can create something truly special for users. We've laid down a solid foundation, not just for now, but for future growth and enhancements too.
